goal: Fix GETADDR and getnodeaddresses responses so they don't fall short of the requested count when many addresses are banned
Filter banned or discouraged peers during selection itself instead of after, to avoid underfilling results
reviewability: A concrete test gap found via mutation testing is unaddressed, and a rival competing PR exists
agreement: Concept ACKs on the direction from several reviewers (mzumsande, frankomosh, sipa)
Unaddressed objection: the AddrPolicy abstraction is unnecessary complexity, a simpler fix exists (fjahr)
fjahr built and pushed a rival simpler PR (#34162) after the author declined to simplify
Unaddressed objection: current tests don't actually verify the underfill fix, found via mutation testing (frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a real but bounded correctness issue in address discovery completeness
Benefit is moderate: peers get fuller GETADDR/getnodeaddresses responses when addrman has many banned entries
A simpler rival approach reportedly achieves comparable results with far less new surface area, reducing this PR's relative leverage
